up: Retrieve approved drugs (therapeutic_flag = 1) whose mechanism of action is classified as a sequestering agent (action_type = 'SEQUESTERING AGENT' in drug_mechanism). Join molecule_dictionary (on molregno), drug_mechanism, and target_dictionary (on tid). Return molecule chembl_id, molecule preferred name, target chembl_id, target preferred name, and action_type. Do not apply row limits or extra filters.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS molecule_pref_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, dm.action_type FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid WHERE md.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND dm.action_type = 'SEQUESTERING AGENT'
